allow.reason: The advisory is an infinite loop in unzipSync on a malformed ZIP64 archive. The vulnerable copy reaches this repository only as @jscad/3mf-serializer's exact pin of fflate 0.7.3, and that package imports zipSync and strToU8 and nothing else - it writes 3MF archives and never unzips one, so the affected function is not reachable. No fix exists to take instead: the newest @jscad/3mf-serializer still pins 0.7.3.
